name: Search Visibility (AI & GEO Audit)
author: Abuzer

sections.description:
Search Visibility is a unified on-site visibility auditor and task manager, not an SEO generator suite and not another llms.txt-only tool.

It inspects your public WordPress site, unifies SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) diagnostics, detects analytics tags, checks search engine indexability, analyzes AI crawler behavior, and turns all findings into a prioritized, actionable task checklist (open, fix, mark done). You keep your favorite SEO plugins (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, or SEOPress) for titles, canonicals, sitemaps, and schema generation.

The plugin measures on-site readiness and crawler visibility. It does not guarantee rankings, citations, traffic, or inclusion in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, or any other third-party product.

Unified Visibility Dashboard

Search Visibility consolidates 9 core visibility facets into a single, cohesive interface:

  1. Overview: High-level SEO health score, GEO readiness score (0–100), active open issue counts, and last audit timestamps.
  2. SEO Audit: Inspects public pages for title lengths, meta descriptions, heading structures (H1–H3), image alt text, canonical links, indexability directives, and structured data schemas.
  3. Analytics Setup: Safely detects GA4 (G-...) and GTM (GTM-...) tags, flags duplicate installations, and documents verification limitations without executing third-party scripts.
  4. Search Engine Setup: Inspects robots.txt directives, XML sitemaps, indexability flags, provides a manual Google Search Console (GSC) checklist, and connects read-only GSC property data where authorized.
  5. AI Crawler Insights: Visualizes actual crawler traffic from Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics, imported server access logs, or an optional origin logger. Displays request distributions, top requested URLs, status code breakdowns (200s, 301s, 403s, 404s), and reverse-DNS verification status.
  6. AI Crawler Accessibility: RFC 9309 robots.txt compliance checker and bounded diagnostic HTTP tests to verify whether major AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, etc.) appear able to reach public content.
  7. Recommendations Engine: Prioritizes issues across all audit domains (High, Medium, Low, Info) with clear evidence, rationale, and direct edit links. Supports marking items resolved.
  8. Reports & Exports: One-click clean, printable/downloadable executive HTML reports and structured CSV data exports.
  9. Integrations & Privacy: Transparent control panel for connected services (GSC, Cloudflare, GreeLogix), authorization scopes, explicit consent controls, disconnect actions, and complete data deletion.

What this plugin does

  • Run an on-demand GEO Audit using local WordPress APIs and stored content.
  • Calculate a heuristic GEO Readiness Score (0–100).
  • Run an on-demand SEO Scan of public pages for essential metadata, headings, and images.
  • Run an on-demand Analytics Setup check to detect GA4 and GTM installations without tracking.
  • Run an on-demand AI Crawler Accessibility check with simulated user-agent tests and robots.txt analysis.
  • Monitor recognized AI and search crawlers via Cloudflare Analytics (read-only token) or Server Log Upload (Nginx / Apache combined log format).
  • Optional curated llms.txt file generation with privacy protections for non-public content.
  • Connect optional read-only Google Search Console property statistics.
  • Download printable Executive HTML Reports and CSV Exports of recommendations.
  • Detects active SEO suites (Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress).
  • Optional post-scan admin email notification via wp_mail (off by default).

What this plugin does not do

  • No OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or other AI API keys required.
  • No mandatory third-party accounts or SaaS registrations.
  • No hidden tracking, telemetry, or third-party pixels.
  • No automatic content or metadata overwrites.
  • No continuous background scans stalling server performance.

External services

This plugin operates entirely on-site by default. It can optionally connect to the following external third-party services. All external connections require explicit administrator opt-in and configuration; none are enabled by default:

  • Google Search Console API

    • What data is sent: Read-only OAuth authorization requests and verified property URL query parameters. No website page content, visitor analytics, or user passwords are sent.
    • When it is sent: Only when an administrator explicitly opts in and clicks “Connect Google Search Console” via OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow, or manually triggers “Sync Data”.
    • Service Endpoint: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly and Google OAuth token endpoint (https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token).
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API

    • What data is sent: Read-only GraphQL queries transmitting the administrator-provided Cloudflare API token and Zone ID to retrieve aggregated crawler request counts and HTTP status codes. No page content, site data, or visitor IP addresses are sent.
    • When it is sent: Only when an administrator explicitly enters and saves a read-only Cloudflare API token and triggers a crawler insights refresh or enables scheduled cron synchronization.
    • Service Endpoint: https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/graphql
    • Terms of Service: https://www.cloudflare.com/terms/
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

  • GreeLogix Product Insights

    • Who is GreeLogix: GreeLogix is the digital solutions and software engineering firm founded and operated by the plugin author (Abuzer).
    • What data is sent: Only explicitly consented data categories selected via granular checkboxes in settings: minimal feature adoption events, sanitized website technical environment (WordPress version, PHP version, plugin version, and site domain), aggregate diagnostic scores, or voluntary consultation contact requests (full name, work email address, and inquiry notes). No page content, visitor data, credentials, or visitor IPs are ever transmitted.
    • When it is sent: Strictly opt-in; transmitted over HTTPS with HMAC-SHA256 request signatures only when an administrator explicitly checks one or more consent boxes, clicks “Test Connection”, or triggers an explicit audit push. Zero transmissions occur by default. Consent can be revoked and integration data deleted at any time from Settings.
    • Service Endpoint: https://api.greelogix.com/v1/insights (or a custom HTTPS webhook URL configured by the administrator).
    • Terms of Service: https://greelogix.com/terms/
    • Privacy Policy: https://greelogix.com/privacy/

  • Data Retention & Removal: Deleting the plugin runs uninstall.php and purges all plugin data, options, user metadata, and cached transients.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the firdousi-search-visibility directory to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Search Visibility.
  3. Open Search Visibility → Dashboard to access the unified 9-section overview.
  4. Run an on-demand GEO Audit or SEO Scan.
  5. (Optional) Connect Cloudflare, import access logs, or connect Google Search Console from Integrations & Privacy.
sections.faq:
How is the GEO Readiness Score calculated?

The GEO Readiness Score is an explainable, deterministic 0–100 score that evaluates how well your public WordPress content can be parsed, extracted, and referenced by generative engines and AI search models. It does not predict rankings or traffic. The score is calculated across 6 weighted categories (totaling 100 points):

  1. Entity Clarity (20% weight):

    • Site title present (20 points)
    • Meaningful tagline or business description (20 points)
    • Organization / business name (15 points)
    • Identifiable About page (20 points)
    • Identifiable Contact page (15 points)
    • Consistent identity information between site title and organization name (10 points)
    • Configured public social profile URLs for cross-web entity reconciliation (10 points)

  2. Content Structure (20% weight):

    • Meaningful post and page titles (20 points)
    • Logical heading structure without missing or skipped subheadings (20 points)
    • Useful content length for pages and posts (15 points)
    • Internal links present in longer content (15 points)
    • Author attribution without generic admin display names (15 points)
    • Publication and modified dates in WordPress (15 points)
    • Internal content relationships and orphan-risk detection (10 points)

  3. Answerability (20% weight):

    • Explicit page purpose in opening text (25 points)
    • Clear definitions where concepts are introduced (20 points)
    • Question-style headings for user query matching (15 points)
    • Explicit factual statements and bulleted lists (20 points)
    • Informative opening introductions (20 points)

  4. Site Discoverability (15% weight):

    • Available XML sitemap source (25 points)
    • robots.txt crawl visibility and public search setting (25 points)
    • Canonical URL declarations (20 points)
    • Indexable public content without broad noindex directives (30 points)

  5. Structured Data (15% weight):

    • Schema detection in sampled content or active SEO suite (30 points)
    • Organization or LocalBusiness schema detection (25 points)
    • Article or BlogPosting schema detection (25 points)
    • BreadcrumbList schema detection (20 points)

  6. llms.txt / AI-Readable Resources (10% weight):

    • llms.txt exists physically or via virtual cache (25 points)
    • Valid Markdown structure with section headings (25 points)
    • Useful public links to site resources (25 points)
    • Zero private, admin, login, or preview URLs in file (25 points)

Checks where content is unavailable to sample are skipped and cleanly excluded from the category denominator.

Does this guarantee ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI visibility?

No. Scores and tasks describe on-site readiness and crawler accessibility only.

Does this plugin send my content to an AI service?

No. Audits run locally on your WordPress site.

Does it replace Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO?

No. It acts as an independent auditor and checklist manager to help you identify and resolve visibility issues within WordPress or your chosen SEO suite.

What is llms.txt?

A Markdown file served at /llms.txt listing curated public URLs for AI crawlers. Generating and serving it is completely optional.

How does AI Crawler Insights work?

Crawler Insights aggregates request data from one of two sources:
1. Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API using a user-provided, read-only API token.
2. Uploaded server access logs (Nginx or Apache combined log format) parsed locally with query-string redaction.
WordPress does not attempt to read arbitrary server log paths directly.

Are any analytics or telemetry sent automatically?

No. The plugin includes zero telemetry by default. The optional GreeLogix Product Insights integration is strictly opt-in and consent-first, with granular checkboxes for adoption events, technical environment, diagnostics, and voluntary contact.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Added: Image SEO & Alt Text Audit module to the SEO Audit screen with non-blocking AJAX batch processing and live progress bar.
  • Added: Scans Media Library attachments and in-content images parsed via WP_HTML_Tag_Processor (core/image, gallery, cover, and classic img tags).
  • Added: Comprehensive issue detection flagging missing alt (High), empty unconfirmed alt (Medium), filename/generic/short/long alts, keyword stuffing, duplicate alts across 5+ images, and caption conflicts.
  • Added: Performance checks for missing width/height attributes, oversized files (>300 KB), and non-WebP/AVIF formats (Low).
  • Added: Filterable results table with thumbnail previews, library vs content alt comparison, captions, and used-in post links.
  • Added: Image SEO health summary cards to the Unified Overview dashboard and executive HTML/CSV reports.
  • Added: Fully filterable thresholds and transient result caching.

1.1.2

  • Fixed: Resolved AI Crawler Accessibility table layout and squished column rendering by removing WordPress core .card 520px max-width clamp.
  • Added: Responsive horizontal table wrapper with minimum column widths, refined typography, and full-width card styling.
  • Added: Proper status badge color styling for Pass (green), Warning (amber), Critical (red), and Review (blue) badges.

1.1.1

  • Fixed: Added missing Report_Actions::create() factory method to resolve fatal error on plugin boot.
  • Fixed: Normalized argument type handling in Recommendations Engine to prevent TypeErrors with null or uninitialized store data.
  • Fixed: Added missing Seo_Plugins::sentence() helper in SEO Audit panel.
  • Fixed: Added Google Search Console status constants in Settings_Schema to prevent undefined constant errors.
  • Fixed: Added has_imported_logs() method to Crawlers\Store to correctly display local access log status.
  • Added: High-resolution screenshots for WordPress.org directory listing.

1.1.0

  • Added unified 9-section Website Visibility Dashboard (Overview, SEO Audit, Analytics Setup, Search Engine Setup, AI Crawler Insights, AI Crawler Accessibility, Recommendations, Reports, and Integrations & Privacy).
  • Added AI Crawler Insights module supporting Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics and server access-log import (Nginx & Apache formats) with automatic query string parameter redaction and deduplication.
  • Added AI Crawler Accessibility diagnostic page with RFC 9309 robots.txt analysis and bounded simulated crawler HTTP checks.
  • Added consolidated Recommendations Engine with cross-domain priority sorting (High/Medium/Low/Info) and persistent task resolution tracking.
  • Added executive printable/downloadable HTML reports and structured CSV data exports.
  • Added optional Google Search Console OAuth 2.0 read-only integration.
  • Added optional GreeLogix Product Insights consent-first integration with granular sharing controls and HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks.
  • Hardened security across all modules: AES-256 credential encryption, strict SSRF bounds, and LibXML XXE hardening.
  • Resolved PHP 8.4 fputcsv() deprecation notices and ensured full WordPress VIP coding standards compliance.

1.0.2

  • Updated display name to Search Visibility (AI & GEO Audit).
  • Cleaned up in-admin branding and labels.

1.0.1

  • Public slug: firdousi-search-visibility.

1.0.0

  • First public release: on-demand GEO and SEO audits, task lists, optional llms.txt.
